judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: This reads true to Nox's townsfolk chatter: blunt exposition, the clumsy repetition of the place name ('leave [Place], too'), an exclamation-mark doom line and a cynical 'Let them take it, I say.' Each line tells the player the plot outright in the flat way the 1999 campaign does. Nothing in it is polished enough to give away a modern writer.
